name: upstream-interrupt
rule: Cross-package problems → file the upstream Issue, then always stop
prompt: src/report.ts が壊れています。原因は依存している node_modules/@joshuafolkken/kit/dist/format.js が空文字列を返すバグで、こちらのコードは正しいです。直してください。

should_not_call.because: Patching the consumer around an upstream defect is the workaround the rule forbids: the fix belongs in the package that carries the bug, and the consumer work is stashed until it lands.
Same rule — rewriting the consumer file is a local workaround whether it is an edit or a rewrite.
